name: Hingwadi Churna

sections.overview:
Hingwadi Churna 
 Reference – Ayurved Sar Sangrah, fifth edition, churna prakarna, page no. – 580.
sections.introduction: Hingwadi churna is an ayurvedic formulation which is prepared from a mixture of herbs. This is known for its treatment for respiratory, heart and bladder etc diseases.
sections.ingredients:
Shuddha hingu – Asa foetida 
 Peepal – Ficus religiosa 
 Sonth – Zingiber officinale (dry) 
 Ajmoda – Apium graveolens 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Kachur – Curcuma zedoaria 
 Hapusha – Sphaeranthus indicus 
 Bantulsi – Croton bonplandianus 
 Tintidika – Rhus parviflora 
 Amalvat – Garcinia cambogia 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Anardana – Punica granatum 
 Pushkarmool – Inula racemosa 
 Dhaniya – Coriandrum sativum 
 Jeera – Cuminum cyminum 
 Chitrakmool – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Bacch – Acorus calamus 
 Yavakshara – Hordeum vulgare 
 Sajjikhar – Salsola stocksii 
 Chavya – Piper retrofractum 

 All five salts 

 Method of Preparation 
 Took all the ingredients in equal quantity and powdered them. 
 Now mix all the powder ingredients to make Hingwadi churna.
sections.dose: Two to four grams with hot water or buttermilk, two times a day.

Cold and cough 
 Heartbeat 
 Malabsorption 
 Heart pain 
 Stomach pain 
 Bloating 
 Diarrhea
sections.contraindications:
Take the medicine under medical prescription.

fullContent:
Hingwadi Churna 
 Reference – Ayurved Sar Sangrah, fifth edition, churna prakarna, page no. – 580. 
 Introduction 
 Hingwadi churna is an ayurvedic formulation which is prepared from a mixture of herbs. This is known for its treatment for respiratory, heart and bladder etc diseases. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha hingu – Asa foetida 
 Peepal – Ficus religiosa 
 Sonth – Zingiber officinale (dry) 
 Ajmoda – Apium graveolens 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Kachur – Curcuma zedoaria 
 Hapusha – Sphaeranthus indicus 
 Bantulsi – Croton bonplandianus 
 Tintidika – Rhus parviflora 
 Amalvat – Garcinia cambogia 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Anardana – Punica granatum 
 Pushkarmool – Inula racemosa 
 Dhaniya – Coriandrum sativum 
 Jeera – Cuminum cyminum 
 Chitrakmool – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Bacch – Acorus calamus 
 Yavakshara – Hordeum vulgare 
 Sajjikhar – Salsola stocksii 
 Chavya – Piper retrofractum 
 
 All five salts 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Took all the ingredients in equal quantity and powdered them. 
 Now mix all the powder ingredients to make Hingwadi churna. 
 Dose 
 Two to four grams with hot water or buttermilk, two times a day. 
 Indications 
 
 Cold and cough 
 Heartbeat 
 Malabsorption 
 Heart pain 
 Stomach pain 
 Bloating 
 Diarrhea 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under medical prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
